thread:
Aisha (PM): Quick sync — we need a compact alignment thread for the 'Launch Currents' pilot. Customer commitment: gen API with Dedicated SLA (p50 ~100ms, p95 ~300ms) and private-onprem pilot for one customer. I want: owner for each dependency, hard dates for signoff, and fallback behavior.

Matt (Eng - Runtime): Can you paste expected qps and typical sequence lengths? runtime needs numbers to pick batching/kv-cache policy.

Aisha (PM): Sure — initial pilot traffic estimate: 20 qps sustained, 100 qps burst. Typical seq length ~256 tokens, 99th seq length ~1024.

Matt (Eng - Runtime): OK that helps. For 20 qps / 256 we can hit p50~80ms on A100 with batching=auto but p95 needs cold-start and KV cache plans. Who's owning prewarm?

Sanjay (Infra): Infra can allocate dedicated pool but capacity booking required by EOW (Fri). We currently have a 10-GPU slot pool free week-of May12; after that lead time is 3w. If you want guaranteed dedicated, we need signed commitment and tenant config.

Priya (Security): For private-onprem pilot we need KMS/HSM review and a threat model signoff. Can we put a deadline? I need docs + architecture by May 6 to finish review before pilot. Also call out where customer keys live and audit log retention.

Aisha (PM): Deadline noted. May 6 for security package. Matt — can you sketch the key flows for KMS and fallback to hosted?

Matt (Eng - Runtime): Sketch below — simple flow:

```
1) Request arrives -> routing -> dedicated runtime if tenant pinned
2) If HSM bound -> runtime requests signing token from KMS via vault proxy
3) If KMS unavailable -> fallback to hosted variant (no HSM) with explicit opt-in and reduced SLA
```

Matt (Eng - Runtime): We need infra to validate VPN/VPC peering and routing ACLs. Sanjay — can you confirm network pre-reqs?

Sanjay (Infra): Confirmed. I need the CIDR list and egress IPs. Also note that private customers require port 443 + mTLS. We'll provide runbook steps.

Linh (SRE): Observability checklist: traces for request -> model shard selection, per-token latency, queue depth metrics, prefix cache hit rate, and an SLO dashboard. Who owns the dashboard?

Aisha (PM): Product will own the SLO definition. Linh + Matt build the dashboard. Can we commit to an initial template by May 8?

Linh (SRE): Yes — will put up a Grafana template and a Prometheus scrape list by May 8. Need metric names from runtime.

Matt (Eng - Runtime): I'll publish metric names tomorrow. Also proposing canary rollout plan: 5% traffic for 24h -> 25% 24h -> full. Rollback hinge: if p95 increases >40% or error rate >0.5% revert. Agree?

Priya (Security): Add security gating: no canary to private tenant until HSM signoff. Also require secrets rotation test to be green in staging.

Olga (Design): One UX ask — surface a short notice to users when fallback to hosted occurs (so support can communicate). We'll ship a small banner component.

Aisha (PM): Good call. Also need a postmortem playbook for degraded-performance fallback (who declares, who flips routing). Linh/Sanjay/Matt own runbook steps.

Sanjay (Infra): I'll draft routing flip steps (DNS, LB weights, BGP if needed) and a rollback checklist.

Matt (Eng - Runtime): Quick note on model variants: we should include a quantized <8bit> variant as a cost/latency fallback. That requires eval pass and quality guardrails. Research will need 2 weeks. Can we accept the risk?

Aisha (PM): Yes — accept but must include quality gates and canary. Add "quant-fallback" to rollout matrix.

Linh (SRE): One more: chaos test window — we should run a simulated KMS outage during staging canary to validate fallback path. Suggest scheduled window: May 9 02:00-04:00 UTC. Anyone object?

Priya (Security): Fine with scheduled test as long as customer keys are not used and test data is synthetic.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: launch-currents/canary -> staging at 2026-05-09T02:15:00Z.

Aisha (PM): Great. Owners and dates recap:
- Product (Aisha): SLO definition + rollout decision (due May 10)
- Runtime (Matt): metric names + canary plan + quant-fallback eval (metrics tomorrow, eval by May 20)
- Infra (Sanjay): capacity booking (commit by EOW), network runbook (May 6)
- Security (Priya): KMS/HSM review + signoff (May 6), secrets rotation test
- SRE (Linh): dashboards + runbook + chaos test (template May 8, chaos May 9)
- Design (Olga): fallback UX banner (May 7)

Aisha (PM): If everyone agrees, I'll convert this to a short kickoff doc and action tracker. Please react with :thumbsup: when you confirm.

Matt (Eng - Runtime): :thumbsup:

Sanjay (Infra): :thumbsup:

Priya (Security): :thumbsup:

Linh (SRE): :thumbsup:

Olga (Design): :thumbsup:

Aisha (PM): Thanks — I'll follow up with calendar invites and a one-pager.
